Title: 500965-2026: France – Architectural, engineering and planning services – Design competition for the construction of a municipal building to house a multiplex cinema and a multi-storey car park
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: New construction of a cinema complex with car park offers interesting structural engineering tasks (large auditorium spaces, car park structure) and counts as a more complex building construction project. Deduction because the location is in France outside the DACH region and it is not a high-profile major cultural building project such as a concert hall.
titel: Competition for the design of a municipal building with multiplex cinema and car park
kurzbeschreibung: A municipal cinema with three auditoriums and a car park is planned in Domont.
umfang: New construction of a municipal building for a cinema with 3 auditoriums and a total of 450 seats as well as a multi-storey car park; site area approx. 3,500 m2; location in a redevelopment area on newly acquired plots AM8 and AM7.
leistungen: Planning services within the framework of a design competition and/or a Maîtrise d'oeuvre contract for the new construction of a cinema building and a car park; specific specialist lots and service phases are not further specified in the notice.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Early competition phase with strategic entry opportunity via architectural teams
• Cultural building with public use and an additional car park generally suitable for sbp
• Possible need for structural concepts for cinema and car park, but without specified special spans or special structures
• Building construction project of medium size, but no explicit indications of exceptional construction, sustainability or innovation
• Location France is generally relevant for sbp, but without special watchlist priority
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs are stated in the tender. For a reliable estimate, GFA, number of storeys, number of parking spaces in the car park, technical standards and fit-out level are missing. The only information that can be derived is 3 cinema auditoriums with 450 seats on a site of approx. 3,500 m2; a rough total cost estimate could, depending on the design, be in the mid single- to double-digit million range, but is not reliable enough here for a numerical figure.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee stated in the notice. Without construction costs, scope of services, team structure and extent of structural design, no reliable fee estimate for sbp is possible.
auftraggeber: Commune de Domont, 47 rue de la Mairie, 95330 Domont, France, Contact: Service Marchés Publics, E-Mail: mp@domont.fr, Telefon: +33 139355522, Website: https://www.ville-domont.fr/
notes: Restricted competition procedure. Duration 43 months. Submission electronically via https://marches.maximilien.fr/entreprise/consultation/943442?orgAcronyme=a1e. Procedure language French. No framework agreement.
